item.tib: mkha' 'gro dkar mo mdangs ldan tshe bsgrub
item.coloph: ces tshe bsgrub (sgrub) zad med bdud rtsi 'di/ mkha' 'gro'i man ngag zab mo zhes bya ba 'di/ mkha' 'gro ma'i (mas) kho bo pad ma g.yung drung la brgyud pa'o/ phyi rab (rabs) don du dben gnas mdzod nag khrod la bkod pa dge legs 'phel//
